title: Change Management Policy Outline
content:
# Change Management Policy (Outline)

**Domain:** general enterprise ops — not legal advice.

## 1. Purpose
Define how production changes are proposed, reviewed, approved, and rolled back.

## 2. Scope
All production systems, including SaaS configuration and infrastructure-as-code.

## 3. Roles (RACI)
| Activity | R | A | C | I |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Raise change | Requester | Service owner | CAB | Stakeholders |
| Approve standard change | Change manager | CAB chair | Security | Ops |
| Execute | Implementer | Service owner | On-call | Status page |

## 4. Change classes
- Standard (pre-approved)
- Normal (CAB)
- Emergency (expedited + post-review)

## 5. Required artefacts
Request, risk assessment, test evidence, rollback plan, communication plan.

## 6. Post-implementation review
Success criteria, incidents linked, lessons learned.

title: Payment Vendor Due Diligence Checklist
content:
# Payment Vendor Due Diligence Checklist

**Domain:** finance ops — not investment or legal advice. Engage counsel for regulated products.

## A. Corporate & licensing
- [ ] Legal entity, UBOs, jurisdictions of operation
- [ ] Relevant payment / money-transmission licences
- [ ] Material regulatory actions (5y)

## B. Security & assurance
- [ ] PCI-DSS AoC / ROC (as applicable)
- [ ] SOC 2 / ISO 27001 reports
- [ ] Penetration test summary + remediations

## C. Operations
- [ ] Settlement timelines & currencies
- [ ] Chargeback / dispute workflow
- [ ] Incident notification SLA

## D. Commercial
- [ ] Fee schedule & FX markups
- [ ] Data residency / subprocessors
- [ ] Termination & transition assistance

title: Patient Data Incident Intake Outline
content:
# Patient Data Incident Intake (Outline)

**Domain:** healthcare operations / privacy ops — not clinical advice. Follow applicable privacy law with counsel.

## Intake fields
1. Discovery datetime (UTC + local)
2. Reporter name / role / contact
3. Systems / vendors involved
4. Data categories (identifiers, health data, financial)
5. Estimated individuals impacted (range)
6. Containment actions already taken
7. Evidence preserved (logs, screenshots)
8. Notification owners (privacy, security, legal, PR)

## Immediate triage
- Isolate affected accounts/systems
- Preserve logs (do not wipe)
- Open incident ticket + severity
- Schedule counsel + privacy lead huddle

## Follow-ups
- Root cause
- Regulatory notification assessment
- Individual notification assessment
- Lessons learned within 14 days
